final: WITH m AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry z, NULLIF(TRIM(s.entrystat),'') st, f.facetfaces ff FROM scanmesh f JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry=f.zoneref), base AS (SELECT AVG(ff) b FROM m), sa AS (SELECT z, st, AVG(ff) a FROM m GROUP BY z, st HAVING AVG(ff) IS NOT NULL), sta AS (SELECT st, AVG(a) sv FROM sa WHERE st IS NOT NULL GROUP BY st), kept AS (SELECT sa.a a, sta.sv sv FROM sa JOIN sta ON sa.st=sta.st WHERE sa.a>sta.sv) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_kept, AVG(a-(SELECT b FROM base)) AS avg_over_baseline, AVG(a-sv) AS avg_over_status FROM kept WHERE (SELECT b FROM base) IS NOT NULL
